detailed_descriptions.en: Wing Commander II continued the evolution of the franchise and pushed the boundaries for storytelling in games upon its release in 1991. Now celebrated in this special 35th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community to deliver the most dynamic version ever released. 35th Anniversary Edition key improvements: WCAT Integration - For the DOS version, bundled with the phenomenal WCAT patch built by the Wing Commander community, restoring the gameplay / audio feel of a 386 PC, improved controls, difficulty choice, and more. The Kilrathi Saga - The coveted Kilrathi Saga version of Wing Commander II comes integrated directly with this installation, for the first time ever available as a digital release. The Kilrathi Saga provides digital music and sound, a re-orchestrated soundtrack, and optional drop-away cockpit support Wcdx Integration - For the Kilrathi Saga version, bundled with the incredible Wcdx patch built by the Wing Commander community, offering features like gameplay / cinematic speed fixes, improved controller support, windowed mode, optional cheats, and more - Bonus extras including manuals, reference cards, ship blueprints, and more - Cloud Saves This 35th Anniversary Edition is the ultimate way to enjoy one of the most important franchises in gaming history. Original Game Description: Ten years ago, you were the Hero of Vega Sector, idol of millions - the starfighter pilot who single-handedly turned the tide of a major Kilrathi invasion. Then something went wrong. You were disgraced, court-martialed and transferred to a backwater outpost. For years, your lightning-quick reflexes and instinctive dogfighting tactics went to waste while the Kilrathi killed your closest friends on the front lines. But Mankind still needs a hero, now more than ever before. And you're still the best pilot in the Galaxy. You've got just one chance to prove yourself, just one chance to keep the Terran homeworlds from falling to the massed armada of the Empire of Kilrah. Think you can handle it, flyboy? Wing Commander II is the sequel to the top action-simulation hit Wing Commander. But Wing Commander II is more than a sequel - it advances the state of the art in computer gaming even further, with new features and new challenges: A gripping story line! All the action and drama you expect from a major motion picture but you're the star! State-of-the-art graphics! The latest advances in 3-D rendering technology give you the most stunning, photo-realistic images you have ever seen on your computer. Intriguing tactics! Fly five different Terran fighters into battle, armed with guns, missiles, torpedoes, chaff pods, tailguns, turrets and tractor beams. But watch out - the Kilrathi have some hot hardware too! Digitized speech! Hear radio messages from your wingmen and foes. Dynamic Intelligence! Every dogfight is an exciting challenge, whether you're a novice or an ace of aces, because your opponents match your skill level. The better you fly, the better they fly! A thrilling musical score! The soundtrack senses the action on-screen and alters the pacing, tempo and mood of the music to match. An elaborate campaign system! The fate of Humanity is in your hands!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Wing Commander II continued the evolution of the franchise and pushed the boundaries for storytelling in games upon its release in 1991.

Now celebrated in this special 35th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community to deliver the most dynamic version ever released.

35th Anniversary Edition key improvements:
WCAT Integration - For the DOS version, bundled with the phenomenal WCAT patch built by the Wing Commander community, restoring the gameplay / audio feel of a 386 PC, improved controls, difficulty choice, and more.


The Kilrathi Saga - The coveted Kilrathi Saga version of Wing Commander II comes integrated directly with this installation, for the first time ever available as a digital release. The Kilrathi Saga provides digital music and sound, a re-orchestrated soundtrack, and optional drop-away cockpit support


Wcdx Integration - For the Kilrathi Saga version, bundled with the incredible Wcdx patch built by the Wing Commander community, offering features like gameplay / cinematic speed fixes, improved controller support, windowed mode, optional cheats, and more


- Bonus extras including manuals, reference cards, ship blueprints, and more

- Cloud Saves

This 35th Anniversary Edition is the ultimate way to enjoy one of the most important franchises in gaming history.


Original Game Description:

Ten years ago, you were the Hero of Vega Sector, idol of millions - the starfighter pilot who single-handedly turned the tide of a major Kilrathi invasion.

Then something went wrong.

You were disgraced, court-martialed and transferred to a backwater outpost. For years, your lightning-quick reflexes and instinctive dogfighting tactics went to waste while the Kilrathi killed your closest friends on the front lines.

But Mankind still needs a hero, now more than ever before. And you're still the best pilot in the Galaxy. You've got just one chance to prove yourself, just one chance to keep the Terran homeworlds from falling to the massed armada of the Empire of Kilrah.

Think you can handle it, flyboy?

Wing Commander II is the sequel to the top action-simulation hit Wing Commander. But Wing Commander II is more than a sequel - it advances the state of the art in computer gaming even further, with new features and new challenges:

  • A gripping story line! All the action and drama you expect from a major motion picture but you're the star!
  • State-of-the-art graphics! The latest advances in 3-D rendering technology give you the most stunning, photo-realistic images you have ever seen on your computer.
  • Intriguing tactics! Fly five different Terran fighters into battle, armed with guns, missiles, torpedoes, chaff pods, tailguns, turrets and tractor beams. But watch out - the Kilrathi have some hot hardware too!
  • Digitized speech! Hear radio messages from your wingmen and foes.
  • Dynamic Intelligence! Every dogfight is an exciting challenge, whether you're a novice or an ace of aces, because your opponents match your skill level. The better you fly, the better they fly!
  • A thrilling musical score! The soundtrack senses the action on-screen and alters the pacing, tempo and mood of the music to match.
  • An elaborate campaign system!

The fate of Humanity is in your hands!
